fusions.name: Churned Spray
fusions.desc: Kicks up a cone of spray 4 tiles long, dealing 6 damage to everything in it. It holds 5 charges and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Barrelling Pass
fusions.desc: Barrels through a target, dealing 13 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after it.

fusions.name: Unflagging Pace
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 18 seconds.

fusions.name: Long-Haul Stamina

riders.text: the small hurts close on their own
you get your breath back between things
and everything you have comes round again sooner

fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your health recovers 12% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 6% sooner.
